in_marathi.name: Anahla
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anahla हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anahla is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anahata’, which translates to ‘peaceful wave’ or ‘unbeaten’. In Hindu mythology, Anahla is the name of a celestial goddess, often depicted as a serene and compassionate figure.
